settings.disclaimer_text: Important Disclaimer: Muzzle Sleep Mouth Tape is generally safe for most users; however, it should not be used if you have difficulty breathing through your nose, if you are obese (BMI over 35) or use a CPAP device without medical direction, or if you have very low blood pressure, severe heart or breathing problems, or untreated sleep apnea. Do not use if you currently have a cold, sinus infection, or ear infection, or if you have severely chapped lips, broken or irritated skin around the mouth, or any active skin condition in the area of application. Muzzle should also not be used after consuming alcohol, sedatives, or other substances that may impair breathing or consciousness. Always consult with a healthcare professional before beginning use, especially for children or individuals with existing medical conditions, and discontinue use if you experience discomfort, difficulty breathing, or any adverse reaction.
